source.title: Original Dragonflight operation-level export search and CraftSim aggregated-export limitation

notes: NEW data-acquisition route checked: current CraftSim CraftLog stores an in-session craftResults collection, while current CraftSessionData:GetJSON omits craftResults and outputs only aggregated craft metrics. Public code is not evidence of measured Dragonflight processing outcomes, and latest CraftSim behavior does not establish 2023 behavior. A voluntary source-original raw craft-event/session export, including event counts, ore/herb rank, output IDs, profession conditions and saved reagents, is needed to calculate material-by-operation hit/zero histograms without inventing denominators. No unindexed original numeric cohort acquired; all measured fields remain unknown/null. Search is deliberately specific to export semantics rather than repeating already-exhausted 2022/23 result tables.
lookingFor: Dragonflight original per-event Draconium Ore (189143 R1,188658 R2), Serevite Ore (190395 R1,190396 R2,190394 R3), Khaz'gorite Ore (190312 R1,190313 R2,190314 R3), Prismatic Ore (194545) prospecting and Bubble Poppy (191467)/Saxifrage (191464) milling raw exports with completed casts, Resourcefulness saved ore/herbs, and 0-N output histograms; verify whether CraftSim export retains needed raw event data
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy: name-first query for Dragonflight Draconium Ore and Serevite Ore original prospecting spreadsheets with per-cast gem outcomes; original 2022-23 Jallfo/Bugy/Xenastro/109bytz/108782r studies already indexed; no unindexed 0-N material event log.

Reddit r/woweconomy: searched Khaz'gorite Ore and Prismatic Ore per-completed-prospect data with refund histories; original 10h6ccx and superbondez sample already indexed; no new independent raw operation rows.

Reddit r/woweconomy: searched original Dragonflight Bubble Poppy, Saxifrage and Hochenblume herb milling result spreadsheets with per-mill pigment output; original Aary and 10me1e7 historical results already indexed, no previously unseen operation-level histogram.

GitHub derfloh205/CraftSim, https://github.com/derfloh205/CraftSim/blob/main/Modules/CraftLog/CraftLog.lua : inspected current Craft Log implementation; distinguishes TRADE_SKILL_CRAFT_BEGIN, UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED and TRADE_SKILL_ITEM_CRAFTED_RESULT events, maintains craftCount and a per-session CraftResult collection. No original public Dragonflight ore/herb player events discovered.

GitHub derfloh205/CraftSim, https://github.com/derfloh205/CraftSim/blob/main/Classes/CraftSessionData.lua : inspected current JSON export; GetJSON exports numCrafts, totalItems, totalSavedReagents and craftRecipeData, NOT craftResults/per-operation output arrays. Aggregated CraftSim JSON alone therefore cannot reconstruct 0/1/2 material hit histograms; a raw session event export would be necessary. This is a tool-data limitation, not a Dragonflight measurement.

GitHub derfloh205/CraftSim, https://github.com/derfloh205/CraftSim/blob/main/CraftSim.toc : checked SavedVariables CraftSimDB and code provenance, not evidence of historical player's sampled sessions or ability to recover 2023 per-cast logs from current files.

CurseForge ProspectMate, https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/prospectmate : checked Dragonflight legacy recipe tracking and instructions to reset data on profession-stat changes, but no published original player SavedVariables export for target ranked ores/herbs.

Wowhead Dragon Isles Prospecting, https://www.wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting : original Bugy ore averages are per ore input and previously represented; do not reinterpret as castsWithDrop.

Wowhead Amirdrassil Drakestalker's Trophy Pauldrons, https://www.wowhead.com/item=207140/drakestalkers-trophy-pauldrons : item identity and enchantability shown; current accessible source did not expose an independently verifiable Looter numerator/denominator, so no gear hit-count record created.

Method Dragonflight pigment source mapping, https://www.method.gg/guides/what-dragonflight-herbs-do-you-need-to-mill-to-get-each-pigment : guide documents output families/skill context, not an original completed-mill rank-separated numeric cohort.

Warcraft Wiki Dragonflight prospect/disenchant reference, https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Disenchanting_tables : explicitly historical general tables (pre-Battle for Azeroth), not a valid original Dragonflight item-specific numerical sample.
